improvement_suggestions.suggestion: URGENT - STILL UNADDRESSED FROM ITERATION 1: Remove owl:FunctionalProperty from :playsInstrument. Change declaration to just 'a owl:ObjectProperty'. This is a blocking issue that prevents correct representation of the story data where Flea plays bass, trumpet, keyboards, and provides vocals.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Eliminates critical logical inconsistency. Allows musicians to play multiple instruments as required by the story. This is a mandatory fix.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: URGENT - STILL UNADDRESSED FROM ITERATION 1: Create Review reification class. Add ':Review a owl:Class' with properties ':reviewedBy' (domain Review, range Critic, functional), ':reviewsAlbum' (domain Review, range Album, functional), and move ':reviewText' to have domain :Review. Update ':criticReview' to link Critic to Review instead of directly to Album.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Fixes CQ9 coverage from 40% to 100%. Enables proper representation of multiple reviews by same critic. Total coverage increases from 0.91 to 0.96.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: STILL UNADDRESSED: Add ':Critic rdfs:subClassOf :Person'. The comment explicitly states critics are persons who review albums.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Creates proper taxonomic structure. Allows queries at Person level to include critics. Improves logical consistency.

summary: This iteration 2 ontology is IDENTICAL to iteration 1 - no improvements were made. The two critical blocking issues remain: (1) playsInstrument is incorrectly functional, preventing multi-instrumentalists; (2) reviewText on Critic instead of Review reification breaks CQ9. Quality score remains 0.72, coverage remains 0.91. The ontology has good foundational structure with comprehensive reification and annotations, but lacks advanced OWL constructs (GCAs, equivalence, property chains) and has a flat taxonomy. URGENT ACTION REQUIRED: Address the two critical priority suggestions to fix logical inconsistencies and CQ coverage before proceeding to iteration 3. Expected scores after fixes: quality 0.82, coverage 0.96.
